source: BBOC 2025 ACC Preview Part 1 + Part 2 (Stuckey/Collin Wilson)
note: 2025 pool: Notre Dame + UConn are independents (zIndependent). Duke + California segments not fully transcribed this pass. Numbers (mkt/sp/tarp/retprod) to be joined from Layer B (edge2025.json) — some mkt values are pod-cited approximations flagged in notes.

teams.key_avoids: Draws 4 of top 6; AVOIDS Miami. Road: Georgia Tech, UNC, BC, Louisville. Opens vs LSU (swing game); closes at South Carolina.
teams.bboc_notes: #1 returning production; Klubnik (36 TD/6 INT) played best down the stretch. Elite DL (Woods, Parker); Tom Allen in to fix run D (gap integrity/edge losses). Secondary the question. Collin ~9.8, small lean under 10.5 — Klubnik struggled vs top-tier SEC competition last year. Both hosts split on whether they WIN the ACC (Stuckey no, Collin more open). Schedule top-30 difficulty; LSU opener determines the total.

teams.key_avoids: SOS 74th — 'schedule lottery 2 yrs running.' Faces all bottom-5; road Wake, Cal, BC. Adds Clemson + Miami this year (host Miami, @ Clemson).
teams.bboc_notes: Defense got RAVAGED — only 2 returning starters, DL lost 4 to NFL, LB/secondary downgrades. Jennings' turnover-worthy plays clustered vs the good secondaries (Duke/Clemson/Penn St). Elite safety duo (Nkoakia, Moses). Collin ~8.3, Stuckey wants to fade (def regression). Collin sees ACC Champ game value (+340) via the soft schedule. Won't get back to the CFP.

teams.qb_status: Transfer — Carson Beck (from Georgia, health Q)
teams.key_avoids: 8 home games; doesn't leave FL until November. Road: Va Tech, Pit, SMU, FSU. Opens Notre Dame + Florida (both home).
teams.key_injury: Carson Beck — elbow (transferred in off injury)
teams.bboc_notes: Loses cam Ward + all top receivers; offense WILL fall off. New DC Heatherman for a defense that was 92nd in tackle grading, near-dead-last vs rush explosives, 120th in penalties. Beck's turnover-worthy rate spiked at Georgia (2.3%->3.8%, 9.4% under pressure). Stuckey much lower (~8, barely 8 wins), hammers the annual Miami hype + Mario clock-management burning overs. High variance.

teams.key_avoids: Good chance to start 5-0 before @ Miami. Terrible spot @ SMU (sandwiched Clemson/Kentucky, SMU off bye). Bye before @ Miami.
teams.bboc_notes: Both hosts like them — Collin makes them 10.2 and calls them possibly the 2nd-best team in the ACC. Miller Moss good fit; elite OL (#1 nation, 200+ starts); RB duo Brown+Watson (Watson 4.8 yds after contact, 30 missed tackles forced on 69 att). Secondary backfilled from portal is the question. DARK HORSE — Collin: could go 10-2 and make the CFP even missing the ACC title game. Best conf price +850. Bet is over 8.5 (-130).

teams.key_avoids: AVOIDS Miami, Louisville, SMU, FSU, UNC. Only plays 1 of top 7 (Clemson, home early). Road: Duke, NC State, Wake, BC. SOS ~42nd (easier than usual). Opens @ Colorado.
teams.bboc_notes: HOST SPLIT — Stuckey 7-7 no play, Collin 5.8 lean under (+125). Kept Faulkner (OC, top-3 in sport) but new DC Gideon (Texas) inherits a defense losing 7 of top 8 DL; was 123rd tackling, 126th pass rush, 100th allowing pass explosives. Two new OTs (one graded 326th). King injury-prone, good backup Philo. Ball-control offense annoys teams. Ceiling ~10 but hard vs Clemson/UGA + short road dogs.

teams.key_avoids: Opens Alabama (likely L). Key swing @ Virginia, then Miami home. Brutal close: @ Clemson, Va Tech, @ NC State, @ Florida.
teams.bboc_notes: HOST SPLIT — Collin under 6.5 (+125) + plans to bet FSU ML home vs Miami; Stuckey 7.1 small lean over. Coming off 2-10 disaster. New OC Malzahn + new QB Castellanos (BC) — fit Q (only 6 yds on zone-read plays; Malzahn wants run). New DC Tony White 3-3-5. OL rebuilt (no returning starters, all transfers). Most-upgraded team by Collin (2 TD better than last yr). Very high variance.

teams.key_injury: Kyron Drones — dealt with injuries last year
teams.bboc_notes: Volatile coaching situation — Brent Pry 1-12 in one-possession games, 0-5 in them last year (tied/ahead at 2-min warning in 4 losses). Stuckey in the minority LIKING the offseason: new DC (2 respected NFL rooms, exotic 3-high looks) + new OC Montgomery (good w/ QBs). Team got gutted; new OL coach + WVU transfers. Drones health-dependent. [Numbers pending Layer B.]
[Segment at 50:00 in Part 1 — not fully transcribed this pass; revisit for QB/coach detail.]

teams.key_avoids: One of 15 easiest schedules (Central Conn, Ball St, FIU, UAB). Tricky: @ Delaware (their 1st FBS game), @ Buffalo, @ BC, @ Rice.
teams.bboc_notes: Best year in 20 last season; seeking 1st back-to-back winning seasons in 15 yrs under Jim Mora. Loses a ton on OL (2 tackles NFL) + defense ravaged by graduations/portal. QB Fagnano (20:4 TD:INT but big-time-throws ~= turnover-worthy) vs more-talented Evers. Both hosts lean under 7.5 (Collin exactly 7.4, no play; Stuckey under). Mora doing a lot with limited resources.

teams.qb_status: Battle — CJ Carr vs Kenny Minchey (freshman)
teams.key_avoids: 2 hardest games FIRST (@ Miami, Texas A&M home). Then very easy: Purdue, @ Ark, Boise home, NC State home, USC home, @ BC, Navy, @ Pitt, Syracuse, @ Stanford.
teams.key_injury: OL Jackasall hurt; TE Rariden question
teams.bboc_notes: Program in best shape in 30 yrs under Freeman (National title game last yr). Loaded RBs (Love maybe best in country + Price, Williams). Elite defense (best nationally defending explosive pass) but new DC Chris Ash (more coverage looks). QB is the worry — CJ Carr (3 INT first practice) vs freshman Minchey neck-and-neck. Collin over 10.5 (+money), 10-2 ND always makes the CFP (playoff bet -160). High variance on QB but very high floor.

teams.key_avoids: AVOIDS Clemson, SMU, Louisville. Road: Duke, Wake, Pitt, Miami. Only 1 of projected bottom-6 in league play. @ Notre Dame; hosts 3 of 4 in Nov (GT, FSU, UNC).
teams.bboc_notes: Program 'falling behind' in NIL era. New OC Roper (hasn't called plays in 8 yrs, more tempo); new DC Eliot leaving 3-3-5 for 3-4. Bailey (soph) had 14 big-time throws to 18 turnover-worthy + nearly 2x fumbles as rush TDs — needs cleanup. Whole secondary transferred out/NFL. OL 129th in havoc allowed, freshman at center. Both make it ~6-7 but both PASS (bad QB analytics, new coordinators). Screams 6-6.

teams.key_avoids: AVOIDS Miami, SMU, Louisville, Georgia Tech, FSU, Pit. Only 1 of top 7-8 (Clemson, off bye). Road: QS, Wake, NC State, Cal. Opens TCU; Charlotte/Richmond/UCF soft.
teams.bboc_notes: Bill Belichick era (+ son Steve as DC, Freddy Kitchens OC). Lost a TON — Gio Lopez (S. Alabama) at QB, 7 of top 8 WRs gone, RB Hampton (1500 yds) gone. Expect good pass D (Steve Belichick pedigree). Huge variance — can NFL guys manage a college roster/season? Both hosts NO PLAY (too much mystery). Hit the scheduling lottery. One of 2 ACC teams w/ new QB+HC+OC+DC (other = Wake).

teams.key_avoids: AVOIDS Clemson, SMU. Draws Notre Dame, Miami, Louisville (all HOME); FSU + GT on road. Bye before hosting ND. Miami last game (cold/weather edge).
teams.key_injury: Eli Holstein — ankle surgery in offseason
teams.bboc_notes: HOST SPLIT — Collin over 6.5 (+115), loves the D; Stuckey off it (7-0 start last yr was fluky box scores, faded to 7-6). Nardoozy D returns 9 of top 13 tacklers, expect 14th-in-havoc replication. New OC Kade Bell (up-tempo, was 5th in tempo at Western Carolina). Holstein 20 turnover-worthy plays — needs OL protection + injury luck. Desmond Reid RB electric if healthy. Schedule breaks well.

teams.qb_status: Battle — Grayson James vs Dylan Lonergan (Bama)
teams.key_avoids: Hosts Clemson, Notre Dame, SMU (Stuckey: rather have on road). Brutal final 8 (many off byes): @ Pit, Clemson, UConn(off bye), @ Louisville, ND, SMU, GT, @ Syracuse. Cal @ BC (Sept 27) = Collin's back-to-back-travel bet ON BC.
teams.bboc_notes: Big step back in the trenches — sent 3 OL + 2 DL (incl elite DE) to NFL, not a heavy portal team. O'Brien wants run + play-action; OL/DL both downgrade. Collin 5.6 exactly (pass); Stuckey under 5.5. Transition year, headed for 5-7. Collin's one bet: BC ML vs Cal (Sept 27) off a bye vs back-to-back-travel Cal.

teams.key_avoids: HARDEST road schedule in the country — @ Tennessee(Atlanta), @ Clemson, @ SMU, @ GT, @ Miami, @ ND (6 top-9 away). Home: UConn, Colgate, Duke, UNC, Pit, BC.
teams.bboc_notes: Both hosts HARD UNDER (both project 4). Dream 10-win 2024 collapses — lost QB McCord (NFL), RB, top-3 WRs, 4 OL. Offense may take biggest step back in the country. Defense lost all 4 all-ACC + spring departures. Fran Brown D was 130th contested-catch, 111th coverage, 120th pass explosives — didn't clean it up. FADE.

teams.key_avoids: EASIEST ACC schedule — AVOIDS Clemson, Miami, SMU. Draws Wake, Stanford, Cal. Swing game @ Cal.
teams.bboc_notes: HOST SPLIT (math vs gut) — both make them ~7.2 but Collin CAN'T bet the over on Tony Elliott (11-25), team perennially 100th+ in tackling/penalties/3rd-down (117th)/quality drives (121st). Big cash infusion -> top-25 portal class incl QB Morris (40 BTT/39 TWP career). Elliott desperation year — may not survive it. Variance + underachievement history = no play despite the soft schedule.

teams.qb_status: Battle — Robbie Ashford (Wazoo) vs Sean Perty (Charlotte)
teams.key_avoids: AVOIDS Clemson, Miami, Louisville. Road: FSU, Duke, Va Tech, Virginia. Runway to start 3-0 (Kennesaw, W. Carolina, NC State home) before bye.
teams.bboc_notes: New HC Jake Dickert (from Wazoo) — power-spread option replaces slow-mesh. QB Ashford runs a lot; lost top-4 WRs; OL lost all 5 starters (4 to P4). Star RB Demond Claiborne back (beast). Collin 5.1, can't bet over (Dickert's defenses declined yearly at Wazoo; bottom-10 in most incl tackling). BUT Collin: 'I'd draft Wake in the over in a win-total snake draft.' New QB+HC (OC/DC) — 1 of 2 ACC teams w/ full turnover.

teams.key_avoids: 2nd-toughest ACC schedule; ~10 hardest in country. Underdog in potentially EVERY game. Road: Miami, UNC, SMU, Virginia. Travels ~26k miles.
teams.bboc_notes: Both HARD UNDER (Collin 2.63, projects underdog in every game). Taylor fired in March, Frank Reich interim (NOT long-term — 'wash the season,' HC search during it). Lost more key guys in spring; 3-9 four straight years. Redshirt-fresh QB or the experienced Gulbranson. FADE — likely another 3-win-or-worse season.
